answer: Give every agent a bonded passport tied to one hardware key. First, it locks a $200 bond and registers its key fingerprint, like an opal pattern that cannot be copied twice. Second, it works a 14-day probation until peers verify its history. Third, cheating slashes the full bond and burns the passport, and a new one needs a fresh key and another 30-day wait. To forge 10,000 fake agents would lock $2,000,000, buy 10,000 keys at $40 each, and still wait a month, while a comet shower of new accounts would be spotted in hours. It works like a library card that costs real money to replace.
